description: Published reference values for non-parametric circadian rhythm analysis (NPCRA) indicators. Used for comparison against single-subject case reports.
note: All values are placeholder reference points sourced from review papers; the field 'n' is null where the original source did not provide a clean cohort size for the cited statistic. Treat as orienting ranges, not as ground truth — replace with cohort-specific values from healthy controls derived from public datasets (MESA Sleep, UK Biobank) in data/reference/healthy_controls.json once available.
